library.kw_018:r_081c360d554055fb.text:
A Zentradi giant enka singer signed to the entertainment agency Vector Promotion.
He also appears in commercials.

library.kw_018:r_ea9df22e0530930d.text:
A counter-terrorism mercenary organisation dedicated to keeping the peace by force of arms.
Its name is taken from the fictional 'silver' of fantasy novels.
Besides wiping out terrorist groups and toppling military dictatorships, it also protects the $$ウィスパード$$.
Its equipment is said to be a decade ahead of any regular army, and it fields the newest hardware before national forces have formally adopted it.
It has an operations division, an intelligence division and a research division; the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s West Pacific squadron belongs to operations.

library.kw_018:r_5c4936ad8b248448.text:
The byname of Marilyn Catt, who commanded the Firebugs.
The $$ファイヤバグ$$ members who revered Marilyn called her by this name - or rather, she had them call her by it.
Marilyn Catt fought alongside the Holy $$インサラウム$$ Kingdom to the very end of the $$再世戦争$$ and died in the decisive battle at Mars.
The members she left behind carry on as mercenaries while searching for a new 'Princess' worthy of the loyalty and the lives they would lay down.

library.kw_018:r_71176d61332d99e5.text:
A special forces unit of $$ＡＤＷ$$'s $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$ military.
True to the name 'arsonist', they served as illegal fire-starters in conflicts everywhere, their shadow behind any number of wars. To carry out difficult missions, every member holds both advanced intelligence skills and mobile weapon piloting ability.
In time, however, the members began to run out of control and left the military, half of them effectively deserting.
The members who remain today are almost all damaged personalities - some can live nowhere but a battlefield, others think of war as the finest game there is - yet all of them swore a loyalty close to worship to their commander, Marilyn Catt.
After leaving the service they operated as mercenaries around Marilyn, and in the $$再世戦争$$ they were hired by the Holy $$インサラウム$$ Kingdom.
Now that Marilyn is gone the survivors continue as mercenaries, but without their former momentum, and both their record and their infamy are becoming things of the past.

library.kw_018:r_4779b8aa1705c824.text:
The independent unit that fought through $$ＡＤＷ$$'s $$破界事変$$ and $$再世戦争$$.
It was organised during the $$破界事変$$ by Elgan Roadick, representative of the $$ＵＮ$$ Peacekeeping Council.
Short for 'Z EXtra International Savers', meaning 'special international rescue team'.
After the spacequake 'Calamity Birth', members of $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ displaced from $$ＵＣＷ$$ joined it as well.
It was disbanded once after the $$破界事変$$ ended, then reformed - at which point it was made an independent external unit with the right to act on its own and to audit and act upon other units within the Earth Federation.
Across both inter-dimensional wars, the $$破界事変$$ and the $$再世戦争$$, it struck down the enemy leadership of many organisations and brought the fighting to an end.

library.kw_018:r_8e1968a00d317603.text:
An electromagnetic camouflage system.
Used in invisibility mode it can render a machine completely transparent, but the mode gives off a strong smell of ozone, so it can be found out by dogs and the like.
It also draws a great deal of power, so second-generation ASes carry no invisibility mode; it saw combat for the first time on the M9 series.

library.kw_018:r_61dd02b7de659989.text:
A great power born from the union of two great nations that the $$大時空震動$$ left occupying the North American continent at the same time: the Holy Britannian Empire and the Union (Union of Solar Energy and Free Nations).
It boasted the largest force in $$ＡＤＷ$$ until the Earth Federation was founded, and even afterwards those from the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$ carried considerable political weight.

library.kw_018:r_8d11adf91da93db6.text:
Hunters who exterminate the hostile alien species called 'Beasts' that appear through spacequakes and dimensional tremors.
An alien species is only classed as a Beast if it disturbs this world's ecosystem. Further, hunters only handle those small in scale and confined to a specific area. On that basis Dimensional Beasts, which are large in scale and appear worldwide, fall outside a $$ビーストハンター$$'s remit.
The Rocky Mountains of North America hold spots where the dimensional boundary is unstable and Beasts appear often, so many professional hunters make their homes nearby.

library.kw_018:r_f3ccb5965d4a0c6f.text:
A mysterious figure who incited the masses over $$ＵＣＷ$$'s most important information infrastructure, the '$$ＵＮ$$'.
Today the name belongs to no one person: it refers to the social phenomenon by which unease and confusion spread through the whole of $$ＵＣＷ$$ as troublemakers who delighted in chaos piggybacked on the first '$$黒のカリスマ$$'.
$$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, the mastermind behind the $$多元戦争$$, also used this name while wearing a black mask and cloak.

library.kw_018:r_2875e8afbcb2e256.text:
A hot spring inn in Atami run by $$甲児$$'s mother, $$錦織つばさ$$.
The staff are as distinctive as the place: $$クロス$$ the manager, Yasu who tends the baths, $$ジャンゴ$$ who handles pick-ups, $$先生$$ the chef, and $$菊ノ助$$ the waitress.
$$甲児$$'s grandfather Juuzou loved this hot spring dearly.

library.kw_018:r_3f597475865697de.text:
A monster from European folklore.
It carries its own severed head in one hand.
Some legends depict it as a knight.

library.kw_018:r_33f9f717c6c37c90.text:
A prestigious private boarding school in the Tokyo Settlement of $$エリア１１$$.
It has both a middle school and a high school, with a very large student body. The atmosphere is free, and between the various events thrown by high school student council president Milly Ashford it was never short of life.
$$紅月カレン$$ also attended as the daughter of her father's house, the Stadtfelds, and was a member of the student council alongside $$ルルーシュ$$ and the others at the time.
That student council counted several people who stood at the centre of the world's upheaval: $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$ vi Britannia, Knight of Zero $$枢木スザク$$, Black Knights ace $$紅月カレン$$, and Nina Einstein, developer of the mass destruction weapon FLEIJA.

library.kw_018:r_e727642da6781c23.text: An amusement park whose mascot character is Bonta-kun.

library.kw_018:r_b0da23abc04016c3.text:
A shock gun that $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ special investigator $$金田正太郎$$ is authorised to carry.
A hit will temporarily paralyse the target's nervous system.

library.kw_018:r_c3e4f5d7214516d4.text:
The great war that broke out in $$ＵＣＷ$$ immediately after the $$大時空震動$$ (= 'Super Robot Wars Z').
As the Earth Federation Forces special unit Chimaera worked in the shadows to bend the world to its will amid the post-quake chaos, conflict between Earth and the colonies and battles against the alien alliance and non-human intelligent life all broke out at once.
In the end the Earth Human Emergency Rescue Union $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ brought down $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, mastermind of it all, and the $$時空修復$$ stabilised the world and ended the fighting.

library.kw_018:r_ee8207e70f8fc923.text:
A base built on an asteroid in the belt between Mars and Jupiter by the remnants of the Principality of Zeon forces who fled the Earth sphere after their defeat in the $$一年戦争$$. It also refers to the faction based there.
Raising the young $$ミネバ$$ Zabi as its figurehead, it schemed to restore House Zabi, and under its effective leader $$ハマーン・カーン$$ sought to profit from the war between the $$エゥーゴ$$ and the $$ティターンズ$$.
After $$ハマーン・カーン$$ fell, the asteroid $$アクシズ$$ was placed under Earth Federation control, then sold to $$シャア・アズナブル$$ - who had newly raised Neo Zeon - on condition that it be disarmed.

library.kw_018:r_aacbf77dc64509e9.text:
A base built on an asteroid in the belt between Mars and Jupiter by the remnants of the Principality of Zeon forces who fled the Earth sphere after their defeat in the $$一年戦争$$. It also refers to the faction based there.
Raising the young $$ミネバ$$ Zabi as its figurehead, it schemed to restore House Zabi, and under its effective leader $$ハマーン・カーン$$ sought to profit from the war between the $$エゥーゴ$$ and the $$ティターンズ$$.
After $$ハマーン・カーン$$ fell, the asteroid $$アクシズ$$ was placed under Earth Federation control, then sold to $$シャア・アズナブル$$ - who had newly raised Neo Zeon - on condition that it be disarmed.
That was a ruse: $$シャア$$'s aim was an operation to drop $$アクシズ$$ on Earth and freeze the planet. The operation failed thanks to Londo Bell's hard fighting and the mysterious phenomenon produced by the psychoframe of $$アムロ・レイ$$'s $$νガンダム$$.

library.kw_018:r_ebb29f0677520d89.text:
The new generation of space colonies inhabited by Coordinators, the collective body they form, and the name of the Coordinators' nation. The name is short for 'Productive Location Ally on Nexus Technology', and doubles as a reference to a large-scale production base.
As a nation, $$プラント$$ is run by the $$プラント$$ Supreme Council. It was once subjected to heavy taxes and pressure by an $$地球連合$$ determined to prevent its self-governance, and that became the trigger for the great war.
As a habitat, the PLANTs are concentrated in the L5 region, one of the Lagrange points where the gravity of Earth and the Moon balances.

library.kw_018:r_4ad52065feebe6ec.text:
An Earth Federation Forces special unit made up of elites born on Earth.
Founded by Jamitov Hymem, with $$パプテマス・シロッコ$$ later taking over as leader.
Established in U.C. 0083 to keep watch on the Spacenoids. In practice, however, it was an organisation built to oppress them, and would not shrink from massacring colony residents with poison gas if it judged that necessary.
Its members share the same sense of being a chosen few, and some behave arrogantly towards ordinary soldiers and civilians.
In the war against the $$エゥーゴ$$, formed to oppose it, the death of supreme commander $$シロッコ$$ and defeat in the battle over the colony laser left it effectively dissolved.
The war between the $$エゥーゴ$$ and the $$ティターンズ$$ in U.C. 0087 came to be called the Gryps Conflict.

library.kw_018:r_3113eda502e87de6.text:
A political organisation demanding the exclusion of Coordinators under the slogan 'for a blue and pure world'. Its members are all Naturals, and it is known for the extremity of its methods.
Many Naturals hold Coordinators in contempt without ever joining $$ブルーコスモス$$, and that too is a result of the group's manipulation of public feeling.
$$ブルーコスモス$$ members have worked their way into the heart of the $$地球連合$$ and its military, acting as the hands and feet of $$ロゴス$$ in pursuit of the total eradication of Coordinators.
After leader Muruta Azrael died in the second battle of Jachin Due in C.E. 71, its activity quieted for a time. But once Lord Djibril took over as the new leader, it moved the Atlantic Federation and the media to steer public opinion and drive the $$地球連合$$ and $$プラント$$ to war once more.
$$プラント$$ Supreme Council Chairman $$デュランダル$$'s exposure destroyed the organisation's upper ranks along with $$ロゴス$$, and its activities were forced into drastic decline.

library.kw_018:r_8f10ec354fa5c3e6.text:
The independent unit that brought $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$ to an end.
Short for 'Z Emergency Union of Terrestrial Human', meaning 'Earth Human Emergency Rescue Union'.
It fought $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, who sought to control the multiverse as his desires dictated.
After the $$多元戦争$$ ended, it regrouped for the battle against the Executors.
Later, some of its members were displaced to $$ＡＤＷ$$ by the spacequake 'Calamity Birth' that accompanied the appearance of the King of Destruction there. They too fought through the $$破界事変$$ and the $$再世戦争$$ in $$ＡＤＷ$$ before returning to $$ＵＣＷ$$ through the $$アビス$$.

library.kw_018:r_7fe26c6d5aa93969.text:
An anti-Earth-Federation-government organisation.
Short for 'Anti Earth United Government'.
It was originally founded by people inside the Earth Federation Forces who saw the rise of the $$ティターンズ$$ as dangerous, but it gathered personnel widely, including civilians and former Zeon soldiers.
Founder Blex Forer served as its representative; after his assassination, $$クワトロ・バジーナ$$ took up his cause.
It brought Operation Maelstrom over the colony laser to a success, struck down $$ティターンズ$$ leader $$パプテマス・シロッコ$$, and won the Gryps Conflict.
In that battle, however, $$クワトロ・バジーナ$$ went missing.

library.kw_018:r_78b7e5332197599a.text:
Full name $$トレーズ$$ Khushrenada.
An executive of the Romefeller Foundation, born to be its heir.
Possessed of a genius intellect and immense charisma, as commander of the secret society OZ he schemed to reform the corrupt Alliance, and with it a weary age.
He objected to the introduction of the Mobile Dolls and, driven from his position as OZ's commander, disappeared for a long time. He returned to the world stage to free $$リリーナ$$, whom Dermail had installed as head of the World Nation, took that office himself, and went up to space to settle things with his old friend Milliardo, now leader of $$ホワイトファング$$.
In the final battle he piloted Tallgeese II, fighting as Earth's representative to bury war forever. At the last he faced $$五飛$$, whom he called the one who understood him best, said he was proud to have fought them, and vanished into the explosion.

library.kw_018:r_0559e33d1b4c397c.text:
An action film made after the fall of the $$アロウズ$$.
Heavily propagandistic, it is built on the scheme of loading the Earth Federation's past scandals onto the $$アロウズ$$ and the figure behind them, with Celestial Being as the ones who bring them down. The $$アロウズ$$' mastermind is given as former $$ＵＮ$$ ambassador $$アレハンドロ・コーナー$$, whose actions were controlled by the $$イノベイド$$ Ribbons Almark.
Heroic imagery is stressed over any pursuit of realism, and the Celestial Being members who appear are characterised quite differently from the truth.
To the people who were actually there, the excess staging and glamorisation is something to grimace at.

library.kw_018:r_239db62b618f8601.text:
The ability to run one's motor skills, thought and reflexes at ten times ordinary human speed.
It lasts only about ten seconds, however, and cannot be used repeatedly.
What triggers the ability is unknown, though touching $$ジェニオン$$'s operating manual is thought to have set it off.
